title: N.C.R.B. (M.H.A.) CRIME IN INDIA - 1999 2.6.3 It is seen that 94.2 per cent of all cases registered in the cities were categorised under `Other SLL Crimes'. Comparatively this percentage at national level was lower at 70.3 per cent, signifying higher registration of cases under Local Laws of the State than under Special Laws under study. The State/Ut-wise distribution of these cases are presented in Table-12 (Chapter-2).
